finalText:
**Migrated 36 call sites across 12 files.** All now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

`node --check` passes on all 12. No tests exist in the repo.

Left alone: `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9)` has 2 calls. Its header says do not edit. Upgrades overwrite it.

Next: get `legacy-orm` upstream to move, or drop the vendored copy.
